sanskrit.deva:
इतीदं कीर्तनीयस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः ।
नाम्नां सहस्रं दिव्यानामशेषेण प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ १२१ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
itīdaṃ kīrtanīyasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ |
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānām aśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam || 121 ||

lines.iast: itīdaṃ kīrtanīyasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānām aśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam

padaccheda.iast: iti idam kīrtanīyasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ nāmnām sahasram divyānām aśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam
padaccheda.deva: इति इदम् कीर्तनीयस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः नाम्नाम् सहस्रम् दिव्यानाम् अशेषेण प्रकीर्तितम्

grammar.en: past passive participle n. nom. sg.

translations.text: Thus this thousand of the divine names of the great-souled Keśava, who is worthy of praise, has been proclaimed in full.

notes: Śaṅkara, before the verse: here the tenth hundred names are explained.

Śaṅkara: ‘thus this’ shows that exactly a thousand names, neither fewer nor more, have been told; by saying ‘a thousand of the divine names’, not of ordinary ones, the count is shown to hold in another way too. Since the question at the start was ‘repeating what is a creature freed?’ (verse 3), this marks the various kinds of japa: japa is of three kinds, aloud, under the breath and in the mind.

sanskrit.deva:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चापि परिकीर्तयेत् ।
नाशुभं प्राप्नुयात्किंचित्सोऽमुत्रेह च मानवः ॥ १२२ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ yaś cāpi parikīrtayet |
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiṃcit so 'mutreha ca mānavaḥ || 122 ||

lines.iast: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ yaś cāpi parikīrtayet
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiṃcit so 'mutreha ca mānavaḥ

padaccheda.iast: yaḥ idam śṛṇuyāt nityam yaḥ ca api parikīrtayet na aśubham prāpnuyāt kiṃcit saḥ amutra iha ca mānavaḥ
padaccheda.deva: यः इदम् शृणुयात् नित्यम् यः च अपि परिकीर्तयेत् न अशुभम् प्राप्नुयात् किंचित् सः अमुत्र इह च मानवः

translations.text: The man who hears this daily, and he who recites it, meets with nothing ill, in the other world or here.

notes: Śaṅkara: the sense is plain. ‘In the other world’ is said to show that even one who has reached the other world meets no ill, unlike Yayāti, Nahuṣa and others who fell.

sanskrit.deva:
वेदान्तगो ब्राह्मणः स्यात्क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् ।
वैश्यो धनसमृद्धः स्याच्छूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥ १२३ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet |
vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syāc chūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt || 123 ||

lines.iast: vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet
vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syāc chūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt

padaccheda.iast: vedānta-gaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ syāt kṣatriyaḥ vijayī bhavet vaiśyaḥ dhana-samṛddhaḥ syāt śūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt
padaccheda.deva: वेदान्त-गः ब्राह्मणः स्यात् क्षत्रियः विजयी भवेत् वैश्यः धन-समृद्धः स्यात् शूद्रः सुखम् अवाप्नुयात्

translations.text: A brāhmaṇa would come to know the meaning of the Vedānta; a kṣatriya would be victorious; a vaiśya would be rich in wealth; a śūdra would gain happiness (by hearing).

notes: Śaṅkara: vedāntagaḥ: one who reaches, that is, comes to know, the meaning of the Upaniṣads, Brahman. Since the question was ‘repeating what is a creature freed from the bonds of birth and the round?’ (verse 3), one might think that japa as an act frees directly; to show that acts are not the direct cause of liberation, which comes from knowledge alone, it says ‘a brāhmaṇa would come to know the Vedānta’. Acts lead to liberation only through the purifying of the inner organ (‘acts ripen the stains; knowledge is the highest goal; when the stains are ripened by acts, knowledge arises … by acts a creature is bound, by knowledge freed; so the yatis who see the far shore do not act’; ‘knowledge arises in men when sinful action wanes’; ‘brāhmaṇas seek to know him by the study of the Veda, by sacrifice, gift and austerity’, Bṛhadāraṇyaka 4.4.22).

Śaṅkara, on the same: liberation is from knowledge alone (‘the knower of Brahman reaches the highest’, Taittirīya 2.1; ‘the knower of the Self crosses grief’, Chāndogya 7.1.3; ‘he who knows Brahman becomes Brahman’, Muṇḍaka 3.2.9; ‘knowing him alone one goes beyond death’, Śvetāśvatara 3.8; ‘not by action, offspring or wealth, by renunciation alone some reached immortality’, Kaivalya 3; ‘the renouncers sure of the meaning of the Vedānta … are all freed’, Muṇḍaka 3.2.6).

Śaṅkara, on the śūdra: he would gain happiness by hearing alone, not by the sacrifice of japa (‘the śūdra is not fit for sacrifice’); the Mahābhārata allows hearing (‘one should make the four classes hear, putting a brāhmaṇa first’), and the Harivaṃśa speaks of a good goal for one of śūdra birth by hearing. So ‘a śūdra who hears gains happiness’, the word ‘hears’ being carried from verse 122; for the three higher classes, ‘who recites’.

sanskrit.deva:
धर्मार्थी प्राप्नुयाद्धर्ममर्थार्थी चार्थमाप्नुयात् ।
कामानवाप्नुयात्कामी प्रजार्थी चाप्नुयात्प्रजाम् ॥ १२४ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
dharmārthī prāpnuyād dharmam arthārthī cārtham āpnuyāt |
kāmān avāpnuyāt kāmī prajārthī cāpnuyāt prajām || 124 ||

lines.iast: dharmārthī prāpnuyād dharmam arthārthī cārtham āpnuyāt
kāmān avāpnuyāt kāmī prajārthī cāpnuyāt prajām

padaccheda.iast: dharma-arthī prāpnuyāt dharmam artha-arthī ca artham āpnuyāt kāmān avāpnuyāt kāmī prajā-arthī ca āpnuyāt prajām
padaccheda.deva: धर्म-अर्थी प्राप्नुयात् धर्मम् अर्थ-अर्थी च अर्थम् आप्नुयात् कामान् अवाप्नुयात् कामी प्रजा-अर्थी च आप्नुयात् प्रजाम्

translations.text: One who seeks dharma would gain dharma, one who seeks wealth would gain wealth; one who desires would gain his desires, and one who seeks offspring would gain offspring.

notes: Śaṅkara: kāma: the going forth of the eye and the other senses, presided over by the mind joined to the self, each to its own object, as it pleases. prajā: offspring, what is born.
Śaṅkara, introducing verses 125–130: in ‘devoted …’ and what follows the special fruit is shown for one specially fit: devoted, pure, ever intent, with one-pointed mind, full of faith.

sanskrit.deva:
भक्तिमान्यः सदोत्थाय शुचिस्तद्गतमानसः ।
सहस्रं वासुदेवस्य नाम्नामेतत्प्रकीर्तयेत् ॥ १२५ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
bhaktimān yaḥ sadotthāya śucis tadgatamānasaḥ |
sahasraṃ vāsudevasya nāmnām etat prakīrtayet || 125 ||

lines.iast: bhaktimān yaḥ sadotthāya śucis tadgatamānasaḥ
sahasraṃ vāsudevasya nāmnām etat prakīrtayet

padaccheda.iast: bhaktimān yaḥ sadā utthāya śuciḥ tat-gata-mānasaḥ sahasram vāsudevasya nāmnām etat prakīrtayet
padaccheda.deva: भक्तिमान् यः सदा उत्थाय शुचिः तत्-गत-मानसः सहस्रम् वासुदेवस्य नाम्नाम् एतत् प्रकीर्तयेत्

translations.text: He who, devoted, always rising (early), pure, his mind set on him, recites this thousand of the names of Vāsudeva,

notes: The edition prints no number with verses 125–130; they are counted on from 124 to 131.

sanskrit.deva:
यशः प्राप्नोति विपुलं याति प्राधान्यमेव च ।
अचलां श्रियमाप्नोति श्रेयः प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ १२६ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulaṃ yāti prādhānyam eva ca |
acalāṃ śriyam āpnoti śreyaḥ prāpnoty anuttamam || 126 ||

lines.iast: yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulaṃ yāti prādhānyam eva ca
lines.deva: यशः प्राप्नोति विपुलं याति प्राधान्यमेव च

lines.iast: acalāṃ śriyam āpnoti śreyaḥ prāpnoty anuttamam

padaccheda.iast: yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulam yāti prādhānyam eva ca acalām śriyam āpnoti śreyaḥ prāpnoti anuttamam
padaccheda.deva: यशः प्राप्नोति विपुलम् याति प्राधान्यम् एव च अचलाम् श्रियम् आप्नोति श्रेयः प्राप्नोति अनुत्तमम्

translations.text: gains wide fame, comes to eminence, gains unshaken prosperity, and gains the highest good.

sanskrit.deva:
न भयं क्वचिदाप्नोति वीर्यं तेजश्च विन्दति ।
भवत्यरोगो द्युतिमान्बलरूपगुणान्वितः ॥ १२७ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
na bhayaṃ kvacid āpnoti vīryaṃ tejaś ca vindati |
bhavaty arogo dyutimān balarūpaguṇānvitaḥ || 127 ||

lines.iast: na bhayaṃ kvacid āpnoti vīryaṃ tejaś ca vindati
lines.deva: न भयं क्वचिदाप्नोति वीर्यं तेजश्च विन्दति

lines.iast: bhavaty arogo dyutimān balarūpaguṇānvitaḥ

padaccheda.iast: na bhayam kvacit āpnoti vīryam tejaḥ ca vindati bhavati arogaḥ dyutimān bala-rūpa-guṇa-anvitaḥ
padaccheda.deva: न भयम् क्वचित् आप्नोति वीर्यम् तेजः च विन्दति भवति अरोगः द्युतिमान् बल-रूप-गुण-अन्वितः

words.meaning: endowed with strength, beauty and virtues

translations.text: He meets with fear nowhere; he finds strength and splendour; he becomes free of disease, radiant, endowed with strength, beauty and virtues.

sanskrit.deva:
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ।
भयान्मुच्येत भीतस्तु मुच्येतापन्न आपदः ॥ १२८ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
bhayān mucyeta bhītas tu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ || 128 ||

lines.iast: rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt
bhayān mucyeta bhītas tu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ

padaccheda.iast: roga-ārtaḥ mucyate rogāt baddhaḥ mucyeta bandhanāt bhayāt mucyeta bhītaḥ tu mucyeta āpannaḥ āpadaḥ
padaccheda.deva: रोग-आर्तः मुच्यते रोगात् बद्धः मुच्येत बन्धनात् भयात् मुच्येत भीतः तु मुच्येत आपन्नः आपदः

grammar.en: past passive participle m. nom. sg.
past passive participle m. nom. sg.
past passive participle m. nom. sg.

translations.text: One afflicted by disease is freed from disease; one bound is freed from bondage; one afraid is freed from fear; one in distress is freed from distress.

sanskrit.deva:
दुर्गाण्यतितरत्याशु पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
स्तुवन्नामसहस्रेण नित्यं भक्तिसमन्वितः ॥ १२९ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
durgāṇy atitaraty āśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam |
stuvan nāmasahasreṇa nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ || 129 ||

lines.iast: durgāṇy atitaraty āśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam
stuvan nāmasahasreṇa nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ

padaccheda.iast: durgāṇi atitarati āśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam stuvan nāma-sahasreṇa nityam bhakti-samanvitaḥ
padaccheda.deva: दुर्गाणि अतितरति आशु पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमम् स्तुवन् नाम-सहस्रेण नित्यम् भक्ति-समन्वितः

translations.text: A man who daily, full of devotion, praises Puruṣottama with the thousand names quickly crosses over difficulties.

sanskrit.deva:
वासुदेवाश्रयो मर्त्यो वासुदेवपरायणः ।
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा याति ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥ १३० ॥
sanskrit.iast:
vāsudevāśrayo martyo vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā yāti brahma sanātanam || 130 ||

lines.iast: vāsudevāśrayo martyo vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā yāti brahma sanātanam

padaccheda.iast: vāsudeva-āśrayaḥ martyaḥ vāsudeva-parāyaṇaḥ sarva-pāpa-viśuddha-ātmā yāti brahma sanātanam
padaccheda.deva: वासुदेव-आश्रयः मर्त्यः वासुदेव-परायणः सर्व-पाप-विशुद्ध-आत्मा याति ब्रह्म सनातनम्

translations.text: The mortal who takes refuge in Vāsudeva, whose goal is Vāsudeva, his self cleansed of all sin, goes to the eternal Brahman.

sanskrit.deva:
न वासुदेवभक्तानामशुभं विद्यते क्वचित् ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिभयं नैवोपजायते ॥ १३१ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
na vāsudevabhaktānām aśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit |
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaṃ naivopajāyate || 131 ||

lines.iast: na vāsudevabhaktānām aśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaṃ naivopajāyate

padaccheda.iast: na vāsudeva-bhaktānām aśubham vidyate kvacit janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-bhayam na eva upajāyate
padaccheda.deva: न वासुदेव-भक्तानाम् अशुभम् विद्यते क्वचित् जन्म-मृत्यु-जरा-व्याधि-भयम् न एव उपजायते

words.meaning: fear of birth, death, age and disease

translations.text: For the devotees of Vāsudeva there is no ill anywhere; the fear of birth, death, old age and disease does not arise at all.

sanskrit.deva:
इमं स्तवमधीयानः श्रद्धाभक्तिसमन्वितः ।
युज्येतात्मसुखक्षान्तिश्रीधृतिस्मृतिकीर्तिभिः ॥ १३२ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
imaṃ stavam adhīyānaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ |
yujyetātmasukhakṣāntiśrīdhṛtismṛtikīrtibhiḥ || 132 ||

lines.iast: imaṃ stavam adhīyānaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ
yujyetātmasukhakṣāntiśrīdhṛtismṛtikīrtibhiḥ

padaccheda.iast: imam stavam adhīyānaḥ śraddhā-bhakti-samanvitaḥ yujyeta ātma-sukha-kṣānti-śrī-dhṛti-smṛti-kīrtibhiḥ
padaccheda.deva: इमम् स्तवम् अधीयानः श्रद्धा-भक्ति-समन्वितः युज्येत आत्म-सुख-क्षान्ति-श्री-धृति-स्मृति-कीर्तिभिः

words.meaning: with happiness of the self, patience, prosperity, firmness, memory and fame

translations.text: One who recites this hymn, full of faith and devotion, is joined with the happiness of the self, patience, prosperity, firmness, memory and fame.

notes: Śaṅkara: śraddhā: the conviction that it is so; bhakti: devotion, being wholly intent. ātmasukha: the happiness of the self; he is joined with that and with patience and the rest.

sanskrit.deva:
न क्रोधो न च मात्सर्यं न लोभो नाशुभा मतिः ।
भवन्ति कृतपुण्यानां भक्तानां पुरुषोत्तमे ॥ १३३ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ |
bhavanti kṛtapuṇyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame || 133 ||

lines.iast: na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ
lines.deva: न क्रोधो न च मात्सर्यं न लोभो नाशुभा मतिः

lines.iast: bhavanti kṛtapuṇyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame

padaccheda.iast: na krodhaḥ na ca mātsaryam na lobhaḥ na aśubhā matiḥ bhavanti kṛta-puṇyānām bhaktānām puruṣottame
padaccheda.deva: न क्रोधः न च मात्सर्यम् न लोभः न अशुभा मतिः भवन्ति कृत-पुण्यानाम् भक्तानाम् पुरुषोत्तमे

words.meaning: of those who have done merit

translations.text: Neither anger, nor envy, nor greed, nor evil thought arises in those who have done merit, devoted to Puruṣottama.

notes: Śaṅkara: na krodhaḥ, na lobhaḥ, nāśubhā matiḥ: with the negative na, not the prefix a-, the three are separate words: anger and the rest do not arise, nor envy.

sanskrit.deva:
द्यौः सचन्द्रार्कनक्षत्रा खं दिशो भूर्महोदधिः ।
वासुदेवस्य वीर्येण विधृतानि महात्मनः ॥ १३४ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
dyauḥ sacandrārkanakṣatrā khaṃ diśo bhūr mahodadhiḥ |
vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni mahātmanaḥ || 134 ||

lines.iast: dyauḥ sacandrārkanakṣatrā khaṃ diśo bhūr mahodadhiḥ
vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni mahātmanaḥ

padaccheda.iast: dyauḥ sa-candra-arka-nakṣatrā kham diśaḥ bhūḥ mahā-udadhiḥ vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni mahātmanaḥ
padaccheda.deva: द्यौः स-चन्द्र-अर्क-नक्षत्रा खम् दिशः भूः महा-उदधिः वासुदेवस्य वीर्येण विधृतानि महात्मनः

grammar.en: past passive participle n. nom. pl.

translations.text: Heaven with the moon, the sun and the stars, the sky, the quarters, the earth and the great ocean are held by the power of Vāsudeva, the great Self.

notes: Śaṅkara, on verses 134–140: by telling the greatness of Vāsudeva, the one to be praised, in ‘heaven with the moon, sun and stars’ and what follows, it shows that the promise of the fruits stated is a statement of fact, not mere praise. And by the sentence within it, ‘of all the traditions conduct is first’ (verse 137), it shows that only one of good conduct is entitled to all the dharmas.

sanskrit.deva:
ससुरासुरगन्धर्वं सयक्षोरगराक्षसम् ।
जगद्वशे वर्ततेदं कृष्णस्य सचराचरम् ॥ १३५ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
sasurāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam |
jagad vaśe vartatedaṃ kṛṣṇasya sacarācaram || 135 ||

lines.iast: sasurāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam
jagad vaśe vartatedaṃ kṛṣṇasya sacarācaram

padaccheda.iast: sa-sura-asura-gandharvam sa-yakṣa-uraga-rākṣasam jagat vaśe vartate idam kṛṣṇasya sa-cara-acaram
padaccheda.deva: स-सुर-असुर-गन्धर्वम् स-यक्ष-उरग-राक्षसम् जगत् वशे वर्तते इदम् कृष्णस्य स-चर-अचरम्

translations.text: This world, moving and unmoving, with gods, asuras and gandharvas, with yakṣas, serpents and rākṣasas, stands under the control of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit.deva:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिः सत्त्वं तेजो बलं धृतिः ।
वासुदेवात्मकान्याहुः क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च ॥ १३६ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ |
vāsudevātmakāny āhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca || 136 ||

lines.iast: indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ
lines.deva: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिः सत्त्वं तेजो बलं धृतिः

lines.iast: vāsudevātmakāny āhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca

padaccheda.iast: indriyāṇi manaḥ buddhiḥ sattvam tejaḥ balam dhṛtiḥ vāsudeva-ātmakāni āhuḥ kṣetram kṣetra-jñaḥ eva ca
padaccheda.deva: इन्द्रियाणि मनः बुद्धिः सत्त्वम् तेजः बलम् धृतिः वासुदेव-आत्मकानि आहुः क्षेत्रम् क्षेत्र-ज्ञः एव च

translations.text: The senses, mind, intellect, sattva, splendour, strength, firmness: they say these have Vāsudeva for their self, and the field and the knower of the field as well.

notes: The edition prints no number with this verse; it is the 136th.

sanskrit.deva:
सर्वागमानामाचारः प्रथमं परिकल्पते ।
आचारप्रभवो धर्मो धर्मस्य प्रभुरच्युतः ॥ १३७ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
sarvāgamānām ācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpate |
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhur acyutaḥ || 137 ||

lines.iast: sarvāgamānām ācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpate
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhur acyutaḥ

padaccheda.iast: sarva-āgamānām ācāraḥ prathamam parikalpate ācāra-prabhavaḥ dharmaḥ dharmasya prabhuḥ acyutaḥ
padaccheda.deva: सर्व-आगमानाम् आचारः प्रथमम् परिकल्पते आचार-प्रभवः धर्मः धर्मस्य प्रभुः अच्युतः

translations.text: Of all the traditions conduct is held to be first; dharma springs from conduct; the lord of dharma is Acyuta.

sanskrit.deva:
ऋषयः पितरो देवा महाभूतानि धातवः ।
जङ्गमाजङ्गमं चेदं जगन्नारायणोद्भवम् ॥ १३८ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mahābhūtāni dhātavaḥ |
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ cedaṃ jagan nārāyaṇodbhavam || 138 ||

lines.iast: ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mahābhūtāni dhātavaḥ
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ cedaṃ jagan nārāyaṇodbhavam

padaccheda.iast: ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ devāḥ mahā-bhūtāni dhātavaḥ jaṅgama-ajaṅgamam ca idam jagat nārāyaṇa-udbhavam
padaccheda.deva: ऋषयः पितरः देवाः महा-भूतानि धातवः जङ्गम-अजङ्गमम् च इदम् जगत् नारायण-उद्भवम्

translations.text: The seers, the fathers, the gods, the great elements, the constituents (of the body), and this world, moving and unmoving, have sprung from Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit.deva:
योगो ज्ञानं तथा सांख्यं विद्याः शिल्पादि कर्म च ।
वेदाः शास्त्राणि विज्ञानमेतत्सर्वं जनार्दनात् ॥ १३९ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṃkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpādi karma ca |
vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānam etat sarvaṃ janārdanāt || 139 ||

lines.iast: yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṃkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpādi karma ca
lines.deva: योगो ज्ञानं तथा सांख्यं विद्याः शिल्पादि कर्म च

lines.iast: vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānam etat sarvaṃ janārdanāt

padaccheda.iast: yogaḥ jñānam tathā sāṃkhyam vidyāḥ śilpa-ādi karma ca vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānam etat sarvam janārdanāt
padaccheda.deva: योगः ज्ञानम् तथा सांख्यम् विद्याः शिल्प-आदि कर्म च वेदाः शास्त्राणि विज्ञानम् एतत् सर्वम् जनार्दनात्

translations.text: Yoga, knowledge and Sāṃkhya, the sciences, crafts and other work, the Vedas, the śāstras, understanding: all this is from Janārdana.

sanskrit.deva:
एको विष्णुर्महद्भूतं पृथग्भूतान्यनेकशः ।
त्रींल्लोकान्व्याप्य भूतात्मा भुङ्क्ते विश्वभुगव्ययः ॥ १४० ॥
sanskrit.iast:
eko viṣṇur mahad bhūtaṃ pṛthag bhūtāny anekaśaḥ |
trīṃl lokān vyāpya bhūtātmā bhuṅkte viśvabhug avyayaḥ || 140 ||

lines.iast: eko viṣṇur mahad bhūtaṃ pṛthag bhūtāny anekaśaḥ
trīṃl lokān vyāpya bhūtātmā bhuṅkte viśvabhug avyayaḥ

padaccheda.iast: ekaḥ viṣṇuḥ mahat bhūtam pṛthak bhūtāni anekaśaḥ trīn lokān vyāpya bhūta-ātmā bhuṅkte viśva-bhuk avyayaḥ
padaccheda.deva: एकः विष्णुः महत् भूतम् पृथक् भूतानि अनेकशः त्रीन् लोकान् व्याप्य भूत-आत्मा भुङ्क्ते विश्व-भुक् अव्ययः

translations.text: Viṣṇu, the one great being, (stands) separately as the many beings; pervading the three worlds, the self of beings, the enjoyer of all, undecaying, enjoys (them).

sanskrit.deva:
इमं स्तवं भगवतो विष्णोर्व्यासेन कीर्तितम् ।
पठेद्य इच्छेत्पुरुषः श्रेयः प्राप्तुं सुखानि च ॥ १४१ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
imaṃ stavaṃ bhagavato viṣṇor vyāsena kīrtitam |
paṭhed ya icchet puruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca || 141 ||

lines.iast: imaṃ stavaṃ bhagavato viṣṇor vyāsena kīrtitam
paṭhed ya icchet puruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca
lines.deva: पठेद्य इच्छेत्पुरुषः श्रेयः प्राप्तुं सुखानि च

padaccheda.iast: imam stavam bhagavataḥ viṣṇoḥ vyāsena kīrtitam paṭhet yaḥ icchet puruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptum sukhāni ca
padaccheda.deva: इमम् स्तवम् भगवतः विष्णोः व्यासेन कीर्तितम् पठेत् यः इच्छेत् पुरुषः श्रेयः प्राप्तुम् सुखानि च

grammar.en: past passive participle m. acc. sg.

translations.text: The man who would gain the good and happiness should recite this hymn of the Lord Viṣṇu, proclaimed by Vyāsa.

notes: Śaṅkara: in ‘this hymn …’ it shows that, since it was made by the Lord Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, who knew the thousand branches, all-knowing, Nārāyaṇa himself, it should be recited with care by all who seek, for the gaining of every fruit.

sanskrit.deva:
विश्वेश्वरमजं देवं जगतः प्रभवाप्ययम् ।
भजन्ति ये पुष्कराक्षं न ते यान्ति पराभवम् ॥ १४२ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
viśveśvaram ajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam |
bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam || 142 ||

lines.iast: viśveśvaram ajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam
bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam
lines.deva: भजन्ति ये पुष्कराक्षं न ते यान्ति पराभवम्

padaccheda.iast: viśva-īśvaram ajam devam jagataḥ prabhava-apyayam bhajanti ye puṣkara-akṣam na te yānti parābhavam
padaccheda.deva: विश्व-ईश्वरम् अजम् देवम् जगतः प्रभव-अप्ययम् भजन्ति ये पुष्कर-अक्षम् न ते यान्ति पराभवम्

translations.text: Those who worship the lotus-eyed, the lord of all, the unborn god, the origin and end of the world, do not come to defeat.

notes: The edition closes the chapter: ‘thus in the glorious Mahābhārata, in the Anuśāsanaparvan, in the dialogue of Bhīṣma and Yudhiṣṭhira, the hymn of the divine thousand names of Viṣṇu, the one hundred and forty-ninth chapter’.

Śaṅkara: by ‘the lord of all …’ it shows that by the very worship of the Lord of all those who praise him are blessed, their ends attained, their work done. And Vyāsa says: ‘whatever falls short in the rites of those who act from heedlessness becomes whole by the mere remembrance of Viṣṇu, so says śruti; if one praised the maker of all with the care with which one praises the rich man for wealth, who would not be freed from bondage?’ He closes: ‘this explanation of the thousand names, bringing every happiness, rooted in śruti, smṛti and reasoning, is laid at the feet of Hari’.
